map.根据鼻咽镜检查中腺样体阻塞后鼻孔的比例进行分级，结合临床症状评估手术指征: Grades adenoid hypertrophy by the proportion of choanal obstruction seen on nasopharyngoscopy, and assesses surgical indications together with clinical symptoms.
map.腺样体肥大分级（鼻咽镜 / 侧位片堵塞比例）：I 度 不超过25%、II 度 2: Adenoid hypertrophy grading (obstruction ratio on nasopharyngoscopy or a lateral film): grade I up to 25%, grade II 26–50%, grade III 51–75%, grade IV over 75%; grades III–IV with mouth breathing, snoring or OSAHS call for surgical removal.
map.腺样体阻塞程度（鼻咽镜下后鼻孔阻塞比例）: Degree of adenoid obstruction (proportion of choanal obstruction under nasopharyngoscopy)
map.分泌性中耳炎/听力下降: Otitis media with effusion / hearing loss
map.腺样体肥大III-IV度伴睡眠呼吸暂停、反复分泌性中耳炎、腺样体面容或药物治疗无: Adenoidectomy is recommended for grade III–IV hypertrophy with sleep apnoea, recurrent otitis media with effusion, adenoid facies, or failure of medical treatment. Endoscopic power-assisted adenoidectomy under direct vision is currently the preferred technique.
map.儿童睡眠打鼾、张口呼吸，鼻咽镜分级腺样体堵塞。: Children who snore or breathe through the mouth in their sleep can be graded by nasopharyngoscopy for adenoid obstruction.
map.腺样体面容（硬腭高拱）评估病因。: Assess the cause of adenoid facies (high-arched hard palate).
map.术前判断堵塞程度与手术范围。: Judge the degree of obstruction and the extent of surgery before an operation.
map.鼻咽镜见腺样体堵塞后鼻孔约 70%（III 度，A/N≈0.75），伴夜间打鼾缺: Nasopharyngoscopy shows adenoids blocking about 70% of the choanae (grade III, A/N≈0.75) with night-time snoring and hypoxia, so adenoidectomy is recommended.

map.X 线侧位片测腺样体厚度与鼻咽腔高度之比，>0.7 提示肥大，结合内镜更准。: On a lateral X-ray it is the ratio of adenoid thickness to nasopharyngeal height; a value above 0.7 suggests hypertrophy, and combining it with endoscopy is more accurate.
